meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能帮你用Python设计、模拟和运行量子电路，包括在Google等量子硬件上执行，并支持噪声建模、参数扫描等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或模拟量子电路，或者需要针对Google、IonQ等量子硬件编程时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个量子纠缠电路并模拟1000次。
say.note: Claude会生成Bell态电路并运行模拟。

say.text: 在Google量子处理器上运行一个含噪声的VQE实验。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design, simulate, and run quantum circuits in Python, including execution on Google hardware, with noise modeling and parameter sweeps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or simulate quantum circuits, or need to program quantum hardware like Google, IonQ, etc.

say_en.text: Write a Bell state circuit and simulate it 1000 times.
say_en.note: Claude builds and simulates the circuit.

say_en.text: Run a VQE experiment with noise on Google processor.
say_en.note: Claude uses cirq-google and noise models.
